propositions: Outbound differ compares in vendor shape while inbound differ compares in canonical shape, creating an asymmetry that blocks the reconciler design principle

Outbound differ's update path reads raw Jira snapshot keys (accountId, parent.key, ADF description) directly in core logic, violating the vendor-adapter seam by forcing core to know vendor field shapes
Snapshot comparison must canonicalize via InboundMapper before diffing, and vendor payloads must be emitted only via OutboundMapper at the boundary, mirroring the inbound differ's pattern
New canonical fields assignee_identity, remote_parent_id, and reporter_identity must be added to InboundMapper output to enable neutral comparison without vendor key literals in core

Partial baseline dict (BASELINE_FIELDS subset) must map through InboundMapper with presence-guarded emission—absent vendor keys yield absent canonical keys, never defaults, preserving opaque stored remote payloads
